// @differs: tsserver inserts the new import and the `export` it adds to `factor` at the same offset (`export import { scale } ...`, invalid); ts-r exports the declaration
// @format: {"indentSize": 2, "tabSize": 2, "convertTabsToSpaces": true}
// @preferences: {"allowTextChangesInNewFiles": true}
// @file: src/main.ts
const factor = 3;

/*[*/function scale(n: number): number {
  return n * factor;
}/*]*/

export const value = scale(2);
